messages.content: Do these four things, each exactly once, as separate tool calls: (1) use the datetime tool to get the current time; (2) use the web search tool for "IANA example domains"; (3) use the web fetch tool on https://example.com/ ; (4) use the image generation tool to generate a simple red circle on a white background. Then reply with one short line per step. End with a line: REPORT datetime=<n> searches=<n> fetches=<n> images=<n>.
